newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise July, Aug rubber futures margins.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise July, Aug rubber futures margins.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Friday it would raise margins on its July and August rubber futures contracts by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Monday.
The increase will raise margins on the July contract to a total of 97,750 yen and on August to 62,500 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The move was intended to cool overheated trade.
Margins on other rubber futures contracts will remain unchanged at 52,500 yen, the exchange said.
